title: The One Who Watches
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the brave voice, and tonight Ezekiel is set on the wall as a watchman to call out to people who had wandered away, so they can turn around and come safely home.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because calling out when it matters takes a brave voice. In Beau’s world today: Beau saw his little cousin chasing a ball toward the street. His throat went tight, but he shouted “Stop!” loud and clear. His cousin froze at the curb and came running back. Just like Ezekiel the watchman calling out to his people, Beau learned that a brave voice can help someone get safely home.
